title: Autonomous computation of a boron-bridged hexazene UV-vis excitation
difficulty_reasons: The fixed object and endpoint are specified, while the agent must formulate an independent computational route, select state coverage and validate the dominant excitation without an author route.

data.description: CCDC record 2512981 retrieval specification and identity constraints for neutral compound 1.
